title: Interop day: committer authority on role changes (bans, adds) on both hubs
description: When Haven keeps the ratchet tree and checks who made a role change (Jason 238470: today only the target role is checked). Extend mimid-chat /roles with variants that give the member role no canBan, and no canAddParticipant; then on Haven's hub (or our copy at the new commit): a ban by a member without canBan, an add by a member without canAddParticipant, and a change not in the actor's authorized_role_changes must be refused; the same Commits refused by mimid's hub (hub/policy.rs authorize_commit).
